title: Chapter 231 Upgrading The Zerg Army
content:
Chapter 231 Upgrading The Zerg Army

The Zerg army suddenly stopped at a certain distance from the battlefield.

Wu Qing felt that it was still a bit reluctant for the Zerg army to go to the war with the current lineup. First, the troops were not enough, and second, the strength did not form an absolute advantage.

The Zerg army could turn the tide of the war by participating in the war in this way, but it was still difficult to defeat the alien human army.

The gap in the strength of the two sides was too large, and how much effect the army of the local camp could play was a big variable.

Wu Qing's principle was to rely on oneself for everything and not to pin hopes on others.

Now the system's gas resource reserves are very sufficient, and the reserves of energy resources have also increased with the continuous exploitation of the Zerg underground world territory.

With sufficient resources and the Zerg encountering a strong enemy as soon as they came on the field, Wu Qing was ready to strengthen the Zerg army.

Wu Qing's choice was very simple, which was to upgrade the one-star troops in the Zerg army to two-star.

Of course, it is not necessary to upgrade all one-star troops. This will consume too much energy. We need to make some choices and achieve the greatest effect with the least consumption.

50,000 Zerg destroyers and 50,000 Zerg dragons are the core forces of the Zerg army. They should be upgraded first.

Zerg destroyers are the main ultra-long-range output of the Zerg army. They have to take the lead at the beginning. After their overall strength is upgraded to two stars, the attack power will not only be doubled, but the killing efficiency can be increased by at least five times!

The second is 50,000 Zerg dragons. There are tens of thousands of griffins in the alien human army, which looks very fierce. One-star Zerg dragons may suffer a loss, so they must be upgraded first.

With the strength of two stars, Zerg dragons can escape even if they encounter an enemy they cannot defeat, and their ability to resist ground anti-aircraft firepower will be greatly enhanced.

The enemy has an air force, as well as powerful long-range attack troops and super-strong defensive ground forces. The main troops of Zerg Hydralisk, which is a long-range attack and air defense, must be strengthened.

The 200,000 Zerg Hydralisks were a bit too many, so Wu Qing selected half of them for upgrading. With 100,000 Zerg Hydralisks, all of which were at least two-star in strength, they could provide strong air defense protection for more than 500,000 Zerg troops.

Even when fighting against enemy ranged troops and penetrating the armor of enemy melee troops, they had great advantages.

The Zerg cockroaches, with their strong defense and self-healing capabilities, could be used as meat shields for the Zerg army.

The Zerg cockroaches fighting on the front line were only one-star in strength, which was still a little weak. Wu Qing also selected half of them, 50,000 cockroaches, and upgraded those one-star cockroaches to two-star.

It was very difficult to kill the two-star Zerg cockroaches.

In general, the speed at which they were injured was not as fast as their self-healing speed.

As for the remaining 100,000 Zerg puppies and 10,000 stealth spiders, one was that they required fewer resources to upgrade, and the other was that they had fewer troops, so Wu Qing upgraded them all.

The Zerg puppy upgraded to two-star strength has a ceiling-level melee strength among two-stars, and is not afraid of any melee arms.

The two-star stealth spider kills enemies like a string.

It is so simple for the Zerg with sufficient resources to improve the strength of the army.

As Wu Qing's order was issued, the various arms of the Zerg army began to upgrade in turn.

At this time, the transport host mixed into the Zerg flying dragon group released all 100 four-star Zerg queens and 100 four-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes.

One hundred four-star Zerg hosts are distributed around, highly alert, and the power of the queen is ready to come at any time to prevent emergencies.

In this public battlefield, in addition to the combat of conventional armies, special attention should be paid to the confrontation between the strong.

Although the intelligence mentioned that the strong men in the evil god camp are watched by the strong men in the local camp, things are unpredictable, there are always unexpected situations, and others are not as reliable as themselves after all.

The local allies around the Zerg army, and those who followed and secretly observed, were all confused by the Zerg army's pre-war upgrade!

"So it can be done this way!"

"Upgrade all on the spot before the battle! How is this done!?"

"Only those whose strength has dropped due to luck can use luck to improve their strength so quickly! Are all the soldiers in this army originally strong?! This is too scary!"

"I heard that this army just obtained a large number of luck beads from the goblins in the main city. Hearing what you said, it is really possible!"

"After this upgrade, the ordinary soldiers of this army have two-star strength! The elite troops of the big tribe army don't have such luxury!"

"The race that the goblins personally arranged to welcome is definitely not a simple race!"

"I have heard of this race. They call themselves Zerg and claim to be a big tribe that has just entered the world. I don't know if it's true or not!"

"A race that has just entered the world? No wonder I have never heard of it! Calling themselves a big tribe may be self-boasting, but they should have the strength of a strong tribe!"

"Although I admire them for entering the world at this time, can they call themselves a big tribe? They really don't know how high the sky is and how deep the earth is!"

"It is understandable that a race that has just entered the world does not understand the situation. I hope they really have the strength of a big tribe and add strength to my local camp!"

"Originally the competition among the three tribes was very fierce, and now there is another Zerg. Now there is something interesting to watch!"

"The strength of the alien race is too strong, and the three tribes are struggling to deal with it. Another strong tribe is just right!"

"Let's see how the Zerg performs on the battlefield. If they can defeat this alien army, they will become famous in one battle!"

"..."

The two tribes that the goblins personally welcomed seemed to be on an equal footing, which attracted a lot of attention to the Zerg.

Now seeing the Zerg's magical pre-battle upgrade performance, there are discussions about the Zerg everywhere.

The Zerg army upgraded according to Wu Qing's request and continued to march towards the battlefield, quickly reaching the outer area of the battlefield.

There are many local camps surrounded here, but these troops are just watching the show and can't participate in the battle in front.

These allied armies blocked the way forward for the Zerg army.

"The Zerg army is about to join the battle! Allied forces ahead, please make way!"

A four-star Zerg host shook the air in the sky and shouted loudly. The sound was clearly audible in the noisy battlefield.

Many people noticed the powerful Zerg army, and those weak native camp armies began to mobilize and prepare to make way.

The four-star Zerg puppy violently opened the way in front of the Zerg army, forcing the still motionless native camp armies in front of the Zerg army to make way.

The Zerg army moved forward a little further, and the Zerg destroyers with increased strength were able to attack the large formation of the alien human army.

Wu Qing felt that the march was slow because of being blocked by the allies, and he could not use force against the allies, so he ordered the Zerg destroyers that entered the range to start attacking directly during the march.

Zerg destroyers do not need to stop and charge to attack, and can attack directly during the action.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The sudden loud noise made the troops around the Zerg army nervous all of a sudden.

When everyone wanted to find the source of the loud noise, they saw a large number of liquid fireballs like molten magma shot out from the Zerg army, passing far above the local camp army and flying towards the square formation of the alien army.

As if a meteorite fell from the sky, the liquid fireballs fell at high speed towards the square formation of the alien army.

The alien army reacted very quickly, and those siege weapons on standby immediately turned around and fired dense giant crossbows into the air.

Those siege weapons that fired giant crossbows, like multiple rocket launchers, can fire a large number of dense crossbows at a time, which is very powerful.

Those human mages who stayed in the alien army and rarely took action, at this time, used all kinds of magic such as earth, water, fire, and wind to the sky to intercept the high-speed liquid fireball shells.

Wu Qing saw the power of mages for the first time in this world!

Falling rocks, water dragons, firebirds, wind blades and other strange magics were cast, and the threat of destruction was very strong. Many liquid fireball shells fired by the Zerg destroyers were successfully intercepted by them.

"Boom...!"

There were only a few thousand Zerg destroyers launching the attack this time. There were not many liquid fireballs above the square formation of the alien army. Many of them were successfully intercepted by the alien army and exploded in the air.

A small half of the liquid fireballs passed through the interception and fell into the formation of the alien army.

The Zerg destroyers were at least two-star strength, and the liquid fireball shells they fired had a huge explosion threat. The soldiers of various arms of the alien army who had been maintaining the formation saw the liquid fireballs falling beside them and immediately entered a defensive posture.

"Boom...!"

The violent explosion blew away all the surrounding alien soldiers.

Some alien soldiers were unlucky and were attacked by three-star and four-star Zerg destroyers. Even if their defense was strong, they could not defend themselves under such a gap in strength and died and disappeared directly.

"Sacrifice of heretics!"

When they found that the dead soldiers would disappear in light, someone immediately shouted and reported to the higher authorities!

This attracted great attention from the alien army.

The killing effect of the two-star Zerg destroyers was much weaker, and the defense of the alien soldiers was too strong!

The outermost layer was the priest's divine art blessing defense, the middle was the heavy armor with extremely sophisticated craftsmanship, and the innermost layer was the energy defense cultivated by the soldiers themselves.

Only by breaking through these three layers of defense can the bodies of the alien soldiers be harmed. The soldiers with the lowest one-star strength were also strong and could withstand strong blows.
